title: Refactor the API handler to use async/await
notes: Complex session with tool_use and tool_result content blocks. Entries c-003 and c-005 arrive under a `user` envelope but carry only tool_result blocks; PSM classifies those as Tool so they stay out of the user turn stream, which is a deliberate divergence from upstream casr. They are preserved so the session can resume with valid context. The file-history-snapshot entry is skipped. Final 6 messages: user(c-001), assistant+tool_use(c-002), tool_result(c-003), assistant+tool_use(c-004), tool_result(c-005), assistant(c-006).
